ICAR CRRI Young Professional I Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR CRRI Young Professional I recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. The walk-in date is 17 August 2026. Candidates should attend the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional I post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month for the Young Professional I position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in Agriculture, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Botany, or Zoology to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional I post?
faq.answer: The age limit for this position is between 21 years and 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India norms for SC, ST, and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: This is a Walk-in recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the Walk-in Interview with all necessary documents on the specified date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the ICAR CRRI Young Professional I recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Young Professional I post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written-cum-Personal Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their performance in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at ICAR Central Rice Research Institute, Cuttack, Odisha. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents do I need to carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Young Professional I position is a contractual job. The duration of the contract is not specified in the provided data.
